connector.name: Gridscoot
connector.registryDescription: AU price comparison via MCP - search, compare, track. 6 tools; anonymous demo (30/day/IP).
connector.summary: Hosted at gridscoot.vercel.app over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the aardappvark account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GRIDSCOOT_API_KEY
env.description: Bearer token from https://gridscoot.vercel.app/account/keys. Omit to run in anonymous demo mode (30 requests/day per IP, read tools only).

env.name: GRIDSCOOT_MCP_DRY_RUN
env.description: Set to "true" or "1" to make the write tool (track_price) return a {dryRun:true, would_call:...} envelope instead of executing. Read tools are unaffected.
